name: get_store_analytics
description: Get the merchant's store performance over a date window: order count, total revenue, average order value (AOV), and conversion rate. Call this when the merchant asks about sales, revenue, AOV, or when you need the AOV to recommend a progress-bar threshold.

fromDate.description: Start date, YYYY-MM-DD. Optional; defaults to 90 days ago.

toDate.description: End date, YYYY-MM-DD. Optional; defaults to today.

name: list_segments
description: List the merchant's existing audience segments and their status. Call this before recommending which segments to activate so you don't suggest ones that already exist or are already active.

status.description: Filter by status. Optional; defaults to All.

keyword.description: Optional keyword to filter segment titles.

name: list_campaigns
description: List the merchant's existing campaigns (discount, progress bar, HTML, image) and their status. Call this before recommending a new campaign so you reflect what's already set up.

kind.description: Which kind of campaign to list. Optional; defaults to all.

keyword.description: Optional keyword to filter campaign titles.

name: get_store_config
description: Get the merchant's store configuration: platform, industry, currency, and the recommendation-box types currently configured per page. Call this to understand the store's setup and industry before tailoring recommendations.

name: get_entity_context
description: Fetch full detail for a referenced entity by type and id. Use it for deeper detail on a referenced campaign, segment, progress bar, or bundle, or to re-read an analytics reference already attached to this conversation.

id.description: Entity Guid for campaign/segment/progress-bar/bundle. For analytics types, the category path: analytics/{tab} or analytics/{tab}/{metricKey}.

name: shopify_rest_request
description: Call the merchant's Shopify Admin REST API. Provide the HTTP method, the version-less resource path (e.g. 'products.json'), and optional query parameters and JSON body. Reads are always safe; perform writes (POST/PUT/DELETE) only when the merchant has explicitly asked for the change, and confirm destructive actions first.

path.description: Version-less Admin REST path, e.g. 'products.json' or 'orders/123.json'.

name: shopify_graphql
description: Run a GraphQL operation against the merchant's Shopify Admin API. Queries are always safe; run mutations only when the merchant has explicitly asked for the change, and confirm destructive actions first. Use variables for values.

name: bigcommerce_rest_request
description: Call the merchant's BigCommerce API. Provide the HTTP method, the version-prefixed path (e.g. 'v3/catalog/products'), and optional query parameters and JSON body. Reads are always safe; perform writes only when the merchant has explicitly asked for the change, and confirm destructive actions first.

name: klaviyo_rest_request
description: Call the merchant's Klaviyo API. Provide the HTTP method, the path (e.g. 'api/segments'), and optional query parameters (JSON:API style, e.g. filter, page[cursor]) and JSON body. Reads are always safe; perform writes only when the merchant has explicitly asked for the change, and confirm destructive actions first.

name: google_ads_gaql_query
description: Run a GAQL (Google Ads Query Language) SELECT query against the merchant's linked Google Ads account. GAQL is read-only. When the response carries a non-empty NextPageToken there are more rows: call again with the SAME query and that value as pageToken to fetch the next page.

pageToken.description: Cursor for the next page — the NextPageToken from a previous response for the SAME query. Omit for the first page.
